property.name: subscriptionKey
property.description-key: Subscription key for Azure Maps.

property.name: azureMapsAuthFunctionUrl
property.description-key: HTTP endpoint that returns an Azure Maps jwt-sas token payload.

property.name: mapDomain
property.description-key: Azure Maps domain host. Use atlas.microsoft.com (public cloud) or atlas.azure.us (Azure Government).

property.name: mapStyle
property.description-key: Azure Maps style name (for example: road, satellite, grayscale_dark).

property.name: defaultLatitude
property.description-key: Latitude the camera falls back to when the dataset has no points (for example 39.8 for the continental US).

property.name: defaultLongitude
property.description-key: Longitude the camera falls back to when the dataset has no points (for example -98.5 for the continental US).

property.name: defaultZoom
property.description-key: Zoom level the camera falls back to when the dataset has no points (for example 4 for the continental US).

property.name: activeRecordId
property.description-key: Input record id to highlight and center on the map.

property.name: searchCountrySet
property.description-key: Comma separated ISO country codes that limit the location search, for example US. When set to US, two letter state abbreviations are also recognized. Blank searches worldwide.

property.name: hideAddPoint
property.description-key: When true, hides the add-point control and disables click-to-add. Defaults to shown.

property.name: hideDeletePoint
property.description-key: When true, hides the delete-selected-point control. Defaults to shown.

property.name: hideSearchBar
property.description-key: When true, hides the location search box. Defaults to shown.

property.name: hideStyleControl
property.description-key: When true, hides the map style menu. Defaults to shown.

property.name: hideClusterControl
property.description-key: When true, hides the clustering on/off toggle. Clustering behavior is unaffected. Defaults to shown.

property.name: hideZoomControls
property.description-key: When true, hides the refocus and zoom in/out controls. Defaults to shown.

property.name: showOpenRecord
property.description-key: When true, a selected point shows a callout with an open button that sets pendingAction to open. Defaults to off.

property.name: openButtonLabel
property.description-key: Label for the open-record button in the selection callout. Defaults to Open project.

property.name: selectedRecordId
property.description-key: Record Id for the currently selected map point.

property.name: pendingAction
property.description-key: Requested map action (add, delete, or open). Read in OnChange to Patch, Remove, or navigate. Use pendingRecordId for delete/open and pendingLatitude/pendingLongitude for add.

property.name: pendingLatitude
property.description-key: Latitude of the point being added (set when pendingAction is add).

property.name: pendingLongitude
property.description-key: Longitude of the point being added (set when pendingAction is add).

property.name: pendingRecordId
property.description-key: Record Id of the point being deleted (set when pendingAction is delete).

property.name: actionToken
property.description-key: Monotonic token that changes on every add/delete request so OnChange fires reliably, even for repeated actions.

property-set.name: recordIdColumn
property-set.description-key: Column that contains the record identifier for output.

property-set.name: titleColumn
property-set.description-key: Optional column used for the pin label and hover text.

property-set.name: colorColumn
property-set.description-key: Optional column with a pin color as a hex value like #C62828 or a CSS color name like red. Blank or invalid values use the default blue pin.
